thread:
jess-support: Hey team — client acct-42 reporting two things: (1) rerank results come back with large negative scores (like -120, -30) and (2) intermittent 400s when they send batches > 50. They attached a sample payload. Can eng confirm semantics and repro guidance?
client-acct-42: adding here — sample payload attached, we hit 400 about 1/3 of requests when we pack 64 candidates. Works fine at 16. Also noticed sudden billing spike yesterday tied to rerank calls.
meera-eng: thanks — can you paste the exact request body + headers? curious about content-type and whether candidates array includes nulls or empty strings.
jess-support: posted anonymized payload from client below. headers: Content-Type: application/json, Authorization: Bearer <key>

```json
{
  "model": "redwood/rerank-v1",
  "input": {
    "query": "how to reset password",
    "candidates": ["click settings > security", "reset via support", "use forgot password link", "" /* empty candidate sometimes */]
  },
  "top_k": 5
}
```

alex-ml: quick notes: (a) rerank returns raw logits (un-normalized) by design — negatives are normal, magnitudes depend on model architecture and score head scaling, (b) client should softmax if they need probabilities, (c) empty strings or sentinel tokens can push logits around and sometimes produce very negative values.
meera-eng: on the 400s — our runtime rejects a candidate list with empty string entries in certain serialization paths (we used to strip but a recent change preserved them), that can trigger a 400 with message "invalid candidate payload". Looks like a recent client payload shape triggers that code path when candidate count > 50 due to batching logic.
jess-support: client says their SDK just does `candidates.filter(Boolean)` normally, but they have older upstream data that can include empty strings. They only hit 400 after switching to a bulk pack that concatenates multiple small requests into one large one.
meera-eng: repro plan: 1) run rerank endpoint with candidates including an explicit empty string in one batch of 64, 2) run with same payload but `candidates: candidates.filter(c => c.length>0)`, 3) capture server logs for the failing request. I can try repro on staging now.
meera-eng: staging repro succeeded — sending payload with empty candidate produced 400 and log: `validation.go:87: candidate entry invalid: length==0` — regression introduced in change set id abc123 (candidate validation tightened).
alex-ml: regarding score semantics: share this short guidance for the customer: "Rerank returns scores as model logits. They are not probabilities and are not normalized across candidates. To convert to a probability distribution do: softmax(scores). Magnitude differences are meaningful (larger delta -> stronger preference) but absolute values aren't calibrated."
sam-billing: about the billing spike — billing team traced spike to repeated retries from client when they got 400s; each retry consumed tokens. We recommended exponential backoff and to only retry on 5xx or rate-limit codes, not 4xx validation errors. We can also credit obvious duplicate retries for this one account — Jess, want me to open a billing credit?
jess-support: yes please, client would appreciate a one-time credit and short mitigation guidance to avoid retry storms.
client-acct-42: thanks — will update SDK to strip empty candidates and add backoff. Any recommended quick fix server-side?
meera-eng: two options: (1) short-term: we can deploy a small change to ignore empty-string candidates during validation (low-risk) — I can fast-track a patch to staging for QA then prod, (2) long-term: keep strict validation but improve error message to be actionable (e.g., return `400 invalid_candidate: index 3 is empty`). I'll propose (1) + clearer error text.
alex-ml: also recommend adding a small help blurb in docs: "Rerank scores are logits — apply softmax if you need probabilities. Negative values are expected." Might prevent future confusion.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: candidate-validation-fix -> staging (meera-eng) by CI #7890.
meera-eng: deploying to staging now, will run client repro and surface logs. If staging looks good we'll promote to prod after a short canary.
jess-support: thanks team — I'll update the client with repro steps: strip empty candidates, avoid retry on 4xx, and to apply softmax when they want probabilities. Also will loop back to billing re: credit.
sam-billing: opened ticket BILL-4321 for one-time credit review.
meera-eng: staging patch green. No 400s with empty candidate (we now drop empty entries server-side). Logs show scores like [-9.8, -1.2, 0.3] for the batch — as alex said, still raw logits.
jess-support: client confirmed they no longer see 400s after patch and have applied SDK fix. Closing but keeping thread for docs blurb and billing follow-up. :tada:
